explainer.counted: Sudanese refugees in Uganda on 31 December 2025, as reported to UNHCR.
explainer.type: A stock: people present at the end of the year, not the number who arrived that year.
explainer.not_included: Asylum seekers, people never registered, and people counted under other groups.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate.

explainer.counted: Sudanese refugees in Uganda as a share of all Sudanese refugees in every host country on 31 December 2025 ({n0} of {n1}).
explainer.type: A share: one year-end stock divided by another, both from the same source.
explainer.not_included: People displaced inside the country of origin, and people counted under other groups.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate.

footnotes.fn_039ff8f7: The figure represents a rudimentary estimate of in situ stateless persons. These estimates were provided by representatives from these unrecognized communities. The estimated figures have not been verified or confirmed by the government of Uganda and UNHCR and UNHCR is planning to support government efforts to gather official statistics on stateless persons and persons of undetermined nationality in Uganda.
footnotes.fn_3df86a34: This figure presents an estimate of persons with undetermined nationality/at risk of statelessness, based on joint outreach mission conducted by the Government of Uganda and UNHCR in September/October 2021, that aimed to provide estimate numbers through self-identification of communities not recognized under the Third Schedule of the 1995 Constitution.
footnotes.fn_7e86a50d: This figure presents an estimate of persons with undetermined nationality/at risk of statelessness, based on joint outreach mission conducted by the Government of Uganda and UNHCR in September/October 2021, that aimed to provide estimate numbers through self-identification of communities not recognized under the Third Schedule of the 1995 Constitution.
footnotes.fn_adf95ca4: The figure is based on the 2024 National Housing & Population Census report which shows that there are 10,284 persons who identified themselves as members of indigenous communities, namely Bagabu, Bakingwe, Benet and Maragoli, that are not listed as nationals of Uganda in the Third Schedule to the Constitution. However, this may not represent the entirety of the stateless population in the country.
